rename.title: Rename thread
rename.description: A model may still be writing a title. Your name wins and is kept.

rewind.title: Edit from here
rewind.description: This message and everything after it are removed from “{{title}}”. The prompt comes back to the composer so you can edit and resend it.

keep.title: Revert and keep changes
keep.body: Workspace files stay exactly as they are now.

files.title: Revert files too
files.body: Put this thread's worktree back to the checkpoint taken before this message.

filesLeft.projectFolder: This thread runs in the project folder, so only its conversation is rewound. Files are left alone.
filesLeft.unsafe: This worktree cannot be restored safely right now, so only its conversation is rewound. Files are left alone.
filesLeft.noCheckpoint: This message has no complete file checkpoint, so only its conversation is rewound. Files are left alone.

rewind.warning: This also undoes edits you made yourself after this message. Nothing outside the worktree is touched.
rewind.ignored: Ignored files stay as they are: {{paths}}. A restore never rewinds them.

method.handoff: This message can't be dropped natively, so h4rn starts a new session with a handoff.
method.native: {{harness}} drops this message and every later turn from its own history.

rewind.checking: Checking what this rewind will do…
rewind.planError: The rewind plan could not be read.

worktree.off: A separate branch and checkout keep this thread's changes out of the main folder.

guest.title: Share with guest
guest.description: One thread, one browser, no account. The link expires after 24 hours, and every message the guest writes waits for you.

copyFallback.title: Copy the link from the field above.
copyFallback.description: This browser would not let h4rn write to the clipboard.

off.title: Guest links are off.
off.body: Turn on Settings → Labs → Guest links for this machine. While it is off, every existing link stops working.

guest.noListener: This machine has no address a guest link can open on. Add a loopback listener, or link this machine to Connect, then share this thread again. Until then the link cannot be opened.
guest.noUrl: The link is still valid for the guest, but this device cannot show its URL. Only an admin device can copy it; after a daemon restart, create a new link to copy it again. The old one stops working.
guest.loopback: This link only works on this machine. Turn on Connect and share again to send a link to a teammate on another machine. A direct link is never sent over a plain network connection.
guest.sees: The guest sees this thread's messages, the agent's replies and its tool output, including anything the agent printed. They cannot see diffs, other threads, files or terminals, and they cannot answer the agent for you.
guest.anyone: Anyone with the link can follow this thread and suggest messages. You choose which ones run.

delegate.title: Delegate a subagent
delegate.description: The child gets its own thread on this thread's host and reports to this one. Approvals still come to this thread.
delegate.taskPlaceholder: Reproduce the failing auth test and report the race.
delegate.hostLocalOnly: Not yet: delegation runs on this thread's host
delegate.note: Cross-host delegation is not implemented yet: the child runs on this thread's host. Blank limits use the daemon defaults (20 turns, 15 minutes, 50k tokens). Cancelling the child cleans up its worktree.

import.description: h4rn reads the harness's own files and shows a preview. Nothing is written until you import, and conflicts need an explicit answer.

problems.unreadable: That harness config could not be read.

share.title: Share {{name}}
share.description: The other machine proxies the server; this machine still runs it, enforces the policy and keeps the credentials.
share.confirmAll: Ask on this machine before every call

problems.pickMachine: Pick a machine to share with.
problems.refused: The daemon refused the grant. Nothing was shared.

tools.title: {{name}} tools
tools.description: Listing starts the server if needed. A test call uses your local authority and is recorded on this machine.
tools.heading: Tools

problems.failed: The call failed. The server status and arguments are unchanged.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: Its configuration and every secret value stored for it are deleted from this machine. Harness sessions that are already running keep their copy until they restart.
remove.problem: The daemon did not remove the server. It is still configured.

skills.secretRefusal: h4rn scans every file in a skill and refuses bundles that contain credentials. Remove the secret (or read it from an environment variable at run time) and add it again.

add.title: Add a skill
add.description: h4rn copies the bundle into each harness's skill directory and keeps the registry row. The original folder is never modified.

problems.noHarness: Pick at least one harness. A skill is only useful where a harness can read it.
problems.noFolder: Enter the folder that contains SKILL.md.

import.title: Skills already on this machine
import.description: h4rn scanned each harness's skill folder. Adding a skill puts it in your registry, which syncs to your other machines through h4rn-connect.
import.manageBody: h4rn marks each folder as its own without changing the skill's files. A newer version synced from another machine then replaces it, and removing the skill in h4rn deletes the folder. Off, the folders stay yours and only the registry copy syncs.
import.summary: {{pending, number}} to bring in · {{handled, number}} already handled
import.noResults: No results. The reason is below.
import.none: No skills found in the harness folders.

problems.scanFailedRetry: The scan did not finish. Try again.
problems.partial: Some skills were not brought in. Rescan and try the remaining ones.

details.same: These versions contain the same files.
details.removeBody: The registry row and every h4rn-managed copy are deleted. A user-owned copy with the same name stays where it is.

problems.compare: These versions could not be compared.
problems.remove: The skill is still in the registry.
